items.html: And afterward, during the pregnancy, the six extremities of the Nefesh were added to her, called the Ruach within the Nefesh; and then she grew to the measure of the Yesod of ZA itself, which is his Ruach, but they are not complete six extremities like his. Afterward, during nursing, the Neshama within the Nefesh grew in her, and her three vessels became recognizable, namely the vessel of Nefesh, the vessel of Ruach, and the vessel of Neshama, as is known, for there are no more vessels than these three. But they are only the aspect of Nefesh, so that the aspect of her ten Malchuts, called a complete Nefesh, was completed in her; and all of them are but one measure, like the measure of the Tifferet of ZA. And then ZA was complete six extremities, and she was one complete extremity.
